project_type: Full-stack web application - React 18 + Vite frontend, Node.js + Express backend, PostgreSQL database on Neon
build_system: npm workspaces with separate frontend and backend packages. Root package.json has concurrently for dev mode. Frontend uses Vite, backend uses nodemon.
test_framework: vitest for frontend (npm run test --prefix frontend), node:test for backend unit tests (npm run test --prefix backend), Playwright for browser tests (npm run audit:browser)
build_command: npm run build (runs build:backend then build:frontend). Backend build is validation only (node --check server.js). Frontend build is vite build.
test_command: npm run audit:unit runs backend unit tests in scripts/audit/regressions.test.mjs. npm run audit:browser runs Playwright E2E tests.
verification_instructions: 1. Ensure database migrations applied (npm run migrate --prefix backend). 2. Run backend unit tests (npm run audit:unit). 3. Start dev servers (npm run dev). 4. Manually test changed features in browser at localhost:5173. 5. Run Playwright E2E tests if UI changed (npm run audit:browser). 6. Check console for errors.
environment_constraints: PostgreSQL database on Neon (DATABASE_URL in .env). Backend runs on port 5000, frontend on 5173. JWT_SECRET required. AI features need OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY but have deterministic fallbacks. GitHub integration needs GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET but can display without them. Never restart the dev server programmatically - manual restart if needed.
contribution_requirements: Phase A (logout backend, activityRepository, projectAuth middleware, migrations 015-019) already completed. Must preserve existing manual task creation. Must not add recurring AI hooks or repeated agent workflows. Continue through phases within available permissions. If credentials block a feature, finish independent work and report the blocker.
key_patterns: Backend: layered architecture with routes -> controllers -> services -> repositories. Repositories handle DB queries (use pool from config/database.js). Services contain business logic. Controllers use asyncHandler wrapper and successResponse/errorResponse utils. Middleware: auth.js (requireAuth), projectAuth.js (requireProjectMember, requireProjectOwner, requireDeveloperOrOwner) already exist. Frontend: React functional components with hooks. Context API for auth (AuthContext.jsx). Services in frontend/src/services call backend via axios api instance. Pages in frontend/src/pages. Shared components in frontend/src/components. Tailwind CSS for styling with custom classes in index.css. Database: Migrations in database/migrations numbered 001-019. Migration 015 (recovery_proposals), 016 (acceptance_criteria), 017 (milestone contributions), 018 (profile_privacy), 019 (ai_usage_tracking) already exist.
directory_structure: Root: package.json (workspaces), .env (not .env.local for backend). Frontend: src/{components, pages, context, services, hooks, utils, layouts}, tailwind.config.js. Backend: src/{routes, controllers, services, repositories, middleware, validators, config, utils}, server.js. Database: migrations/, seeds/. Scripts: audit/ (tests). Docs: architecture.md, api-contracts.md. Node_modules in root, frontend, backend.
